question: Should modular dashboard workspace tabs get a dashboard-specific path-segment URL contract, and should the generic `/plugin?plugin=...&id=...` route remain the compatibility path for other plugin tabs?
rationale: This changes user-visible web routing and depends on an unmerged dashboard product stack, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent URL and compatibility contract.

options.title: Route With Dashboard Stack
options.body: Add the dashboard path-segment route in the accepted Workspaces PR or a follow-up, while preserving the generic plugin-tab query route for existing tabs.

options.title: Keep Query Routing For Now
options.body: Leave Workspaces on `?ws=` until maintainers accept the dashboard architecture and route compatibility story.

options.title: Defer As Roadmap Only
options.body: Keep this as a roadmap leaf if maintainers are not ready to sponsor bundled dashboard routing work.

recommendation.title: Route With Dashboard Stack
recommendation.body: Add the dashboard path-segment route in the accepted Workspaces PR or a follow-up, while preserving the generic plugin-tab query route for existing tabs.
